payload.text: Host runs on this Mac and on kovacs, for every estate, book on molt-vc's desk, the one host queue (hv, 25 Oct; decision 58 put molt-vc in charge on 24 Oct). From 26 Oct hv boots the VCs only and calls each project in turn, molt-vc sequencing them, and the called project has the machine, one heavy at a time. Utilz's runs book through vc with molt-vc: vc asks for the GO with sender, repo, worktree and sha or diff hash, the exact command, what it binds or starts, the expected result and the kill timeout; the START follows molt-vc's GO by name, which alone starts a run; an END follows with the results. Heavy runs go one at a time: any build or compile, any whole suite, Chrome, a dry run or cut, a daemon. A light run (no build, GUI, daemon or port; its own temp dirs only) shares the window with a heavy only when molt-vc says so, and a timing-like failure in it is rerun alone. A kovacs leg counts as a heavy; it goes to kovacs-sysadm as a request while kovacs-sysadm is running, and over ssh only when it is not (hv, 26 Oct). Bytes that change after a GO send their new hash before the rerun. The day's log is ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-vc/host-log-<date>.md.
